notes.title: GUNCHO New Outlaws (Update 74)
notes.content:
Howdy Partner!

This is update 74, our first minor content update!

3 new outlaws have been spotted, make sure your revolver is ready.
We also added 3 new songs for your wild west cravings.

[previewyoutube=A8--eq432hM;full][/previewyoutube]

What’s new?

Added: 3 new outlaws.
Added: 3 new songs.
Fixed: Lot's of small issues.

See you in the Wild West!

🤠

notes.title: GUNCHO Update 73
notes.content:
Howdy Partner!

This is update 73, another bugfix and QoL update.

What’s new?

Added: Boss music track now also plays in Puzzle mode.
Changed: Enemy attack notifiers (!) now have a little bounce animation to be better visible.
Changed: Fires that are about to extinguish change their appearance.
Changed: Kamikaze now have a 1-turn delay when spawning.
Changed: Woodcutter can now cut down Cacti if he's targeting one.
Fixed: Camera/Cylinder rotation not saved when game state is restored.
Fixed: Death replay can be restarted while already playing.
Fixed: GUNCHO does not die when swapping with Tarling onto a burning tile.
Fixed: In Puzzle mode the explosive bullets start in random positions.
Fixed: When the last enemy can't find a path to GUNCHO he just stands still.
Fixed: When shooting an explosive bullet at Tarling with 1 HP he does not die.

See you in the Wild West!

🤠

notes.title: GUNCHO Update 67
notes.content:
Howdy Partner!

This is update 67.

By popular demand we've added a Puzzle-Mode, that displays turn-order numbers for all you brainiacs out there. We've also added the option to replay the daily game (without a score).

Also: We are still hoping for 50 reviews. So you know what todo 🤠.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790685/848c33da1b9571918c71eb6190f05cdc852191e7.png[/img]

What’s new?

Added: Puzzle Mode.
Added: Daily now replayable (without score).
Changed: Demo achievement now available in full game.
Fixed: Highscore list not cleared after switch.
Fixed: Spawn on burning tiles.
Fixed: When Guncho gets stunned while multi-shooting he continues to shoot.
Fixed: Tarling can die from explosive bullets.


See you in the Wild West!

🤠

notes.title: GUNCHO Update 64
notes.content:
Howdy Partner!

This is update 64.

[b]Important:[/b]
If you encounter a bug where the game does not continue to spawn new enemies please use the following debug command - CTRL+SHIFT+D, this will send some debug information to us, so we can find out what's happening. 

What’s new?

Added: Tutorial step that shows the turn order is random. 
Added: Visual indication the Rush is active.
 Fixed: Stun ammo does not stun boss when barrel is hit next to him. 
Fixed: Steak Veteran not reset when game lost. 
Fixed: Knockback bullet target and Kick target does not slip on oil. 
Fixed: Move preview does not show stun, when slipping off an oil tile at the edge of the level into a wall. Fixed: Game service login does not stop when the user don't want to login.
 Fixed: When an ability is selected on steam deck, L1/R1 don't switch to move or bullet. 
Fixed: Death warning menu does not correctly resume to move on steam deck. 
Fixed: Normal and Expert Streak Achievements not correctly display in menu.

See you in the Wild West!

🤠
